name: 20759-sonnet-70b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one a3 node (--gres=gpu:8), driver 570.195.03.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 80 layers, 64 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 8192, bf16; 70.6B params = 141 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent, streams=27, pinned rather than searched. Closed loop: a new request is released the moment one completes, so the arrival rate is not set directly -- it is whatever 27 in flight returns at this request shape, about 10 req/s. Warmup is 10% and drops the first 60 of the 600 requests; the declared 10% cooldown is sized against `safety_seconds` (1800 s) rather than the ~60 s of arrivals, so its window opens after the last request completes and never fires. ~540 requests are scored.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn -- a 200-token prefix shared by every request (prefix_count 1) plus a 350-token body, so 550 prompt tokens in, pinned exact. Output length is drawn uniformly from 50..250 tokens, mean 150, from the run seed, so it is the same sequence on every run of this setup; generation is forced to the drawn length with EOS ignored. 600 requests. Prefix caching is off, so the shared prefix is prefilled for every request rather than once. Declared lengths are the dataset column and not the wire: prefix and prompt are rendered through the chat template, so the engine's own prompt_token_ids run a few tokens higher and that engine count is what is reported.
purpose: A 70B-parameter assistant answering single-turn questions with a shared instruction preamble, 27 concurrent streams on eight GPUs.
launch:
# NousResearch's is the standard ungated mirror of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct weights
# (Llama 3.1 Community License) -- same checkpoint, not a substitution of model.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 8
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096

# PINNED: 8192 / 1024 is what `vllm serve` picks on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card, but an in-process
# engine build falls through to the SchedulerConfig defaults (2048 / 128) instead.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
